definitions.explanation: an organized set of principles, procedures, or components working together as a unified whole

examples.japanese: システムに{障害|しょうがい}が{発生|はっせい}した。
{新|あたら}しいシステムを{導入|どうにゅう}する。
このシステムは{使|つか}いやすい。
examples.english: This system is easy to use.

notes:
システム is a loanword from English "system." It is widely used in both technical (IT) and general contexts to mean an organized structure, method, or set of procedures.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- システム{開発|かいはつ}: system development
- システム{管理者|かんりしゃ}: system administrator
- システム{障害|しょうがい}: system failure/outage
- システム{構築|こうちく}: system building/construction
- オペレーティングシステム: operating system (OS)

SIMILAR JAPANESE WORDS:
- {制度|せいど}: system (institutional/social — laws, rules, frameworks)
- {体系|たいけい}: system (organized structure of knowledge or theory)
- {仕組|しく}み: mechanism, how something works
- システム: system (broad use — IT, business processes, methods)

NOTE:
In everyday Japanese, システム often refers to the way something is organized: この{店|みせ}のシステム (how this restaurant works, e.g., ordering process).
